drift.retrieval: RetrievalCloudDrift = 100 × JSD(frozen retrieved-context distribution || frozen retrieval reference)
drift.rule: Do not redefine StructuralCloudDrift after observing K5/K10.
drift.structural: CloudDrift = 100 × JSD(frozen structural context distribution || frozen reference)

modes.full: agent-supervised end-to-end local appliance and release verification
modes.verify: read-only local verification; no git reconciliation or scientific rerun

scientific_claim_corrections.k5_k10_g_association: Aggregate K5→K10 deltas are descriptive; H0_GA remains inference-pending until paired/per-case or multi-condition evidence is tested.
scientific_claim_corrections.model_agreement: Exact agreement may be reported. Cohen kappa is reported only if category variation makes it defined and informative.
scientific_claim_corrections.model_superiority: No superiority claim until prospective held-out predictions are scored and compared against each other and a preregistered null predictor.
